description: This PHP class 'CopyActivityModel' is part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system, specifically within the Time plugin API models. It models the data structure for copying project activities, containing properties for project activities from a source project and their duplicated counterparts, and provides a method to serialize this data into an array. The class implements interfaces for collection normalizable and constructor argument awareness, and utilizes traits related to project services.

classes.name: CopyActivityModel
classes.description: Models data for copying project activities within the Time plugin API, serializing project and duplicated activities for external use.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with arrays of project activities and their duplicates.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model's project activities and duplication info into an associative array for output.
